نعتني (form VIII)
# نَعْتَنِي (naʕtanī) /naʕ.ta.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
# نَعْتَنِيَ (naʕtaniya) /naʕ.ta.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
